anyOf.description: Markdown prose — the default shape of a reply.

path.description: Repository-relative file path; null when the snippet is free-standing.

startLine.description: 1-based line the listing starts at; null when unanchored.

anyOf.description:
A source listing. Path and
StartLine anchor it in a repository when the
fragment was read from one.
A diagram carried as its source text; the console renders it.

tokens.description: Reasoning tokens the model reported; null when unknown.

anyOf.description: The model's visible reasoning — collapsed by default in the console.

name.description: Tool name as the runtime knows it (`create_ticket`, …).

inputJson.description: Arguments the tool was called with, as JSON.

outputJson.description: Observation payload as JSON; null while running.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds; null while running.

anyOf.description:
One tool invocation. A running call is journalled with
string ToolPartStatuses.Running and no output; the terminal
form carries the observation.

query.description: Search query that opens the destination.

anyOf.description:
A hand-off to a screen. The console resolves the query through the
same search shapes the command palette uses, so chat and palette
cannot disagree about where an answer lives.

id.description: Node id, unique inside the plan (e.g. `n1`).

title.description: Short human title of the step.

profileKey.description: Worker profile key from the catalog (e.g. `implement`).

brief.description: The worker brief — what this step must produce.

items.description: One step of a plan, executed by one worker with one profile.
A dependency: To starts after From finishes.

anyOf.description:
The decomposition DAG — the approve card. Nodes and edges are the
canonical Plan shapes, so a part and a plan payload
never drift apart.

description:
One fragment of a chat message. A message is an ordered list of parts,
            so a single assistant turn can carry prose, three tool calls and a plan
            card without becoming five unrelated transcript rows.
            The union is closed to nested records (private constructor) and
discriminated on the wire by kind — the keys live in
MessagePartKinds. New kinds are added here as further
nested records plus a JsonDerivedTypeAttribute line; the
P2 question/decision parts land exactly that way.
